title: CORE Variable Binding v1
description: Schema for a variable binding that maps slot names to concrete values, resolving a parametric template into a compilable command_candidate. All bound values must pass slot type validation.

template_id.description: Reference to the parametric template this binding resolves.

template_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the resolved template. Must match the template's template_fingerprint exactly.

value.description: The concrete value bound to this slot.

source.description: How the binding was obtained. 'explicit' = user provided, 'inferred' = classifier extracted, 'default' = template default.

bindings.description: Map of slot name to {value, source} binding pairs.
